name: ISO 20275 Entity Legal Forms code list (GLEIF), version 1.6
note: GLEIF is the ISO 20275 registration authority, so this is the registry itself rather
than a redistribution of it. The same relationship `iso-4217-six` has to currency
codes, and treated the same way for the same reason.
That reason is that entity legal forms are statutory facts. `GmbH` is an abbreviation
because the Gesetz betreffend die Gesellschaften mit beschraenkter Haftung says so,
and Germany having such a form is a fact about German law rather than anything GLEIF
authored. What is extracted here is that set of facts -- which forms a jurisdiction
has and what each is abbreviated to -- and not GLEIF's selection or arrangement.
`public-facts` records that reasoning rather than asserting a grant GLEIF has not
made. Worth being exact about, because GLEIF does grant CC0 in two nearby places and
neither one covers this file: the Open Source page grants it for GLEIF's software,
and the LEI Data Terms of Use grant it for `data available through the Access
Service`. The code list is published separately from both. Reading either statement
as covering this download would be convenient and wrong.
Keyed by country and language together, which is what makes it better than the list
it replaces rather than merely differently licensed. `de_AT` gets Austrian forms and
`de_CH` Swiss ones, because Austrian and Swiss company law are not German company
law -- a distinction no hand-curated list had drawn.
